items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: two of them like, be up and down the street, like on Marty Roddy.

ctx.x: I wanted to ask you about St. Joseph's Night at the Indians. Oh, here?

Yeah. Well, yeah, I'll tell you something about that. I never played no dance. I played dance on that, but what I mean, it wasn't just some people in Mass and come to the dance and dance, you know. But I mean, two of them like, be up and down the street, like on Marty Roddy. But did Mass all right, did Mass and come to the dance. The Indians would dress up? Well, different ones, the Indians, what do you call them, the other ones, the Yallapocahomans and all of them would come, you know, dancing. But the most time…
How many bands would they have out on a Mardi Gras day, you figure?
